_comment: Smoke-test-only params file. Not used for real experiments — see .specs/architecture/refactor-plan.md Phase 1 and .specs/quality/testing-strategy.md. Points at DATA/daninhas_micro/, a 10%-stratified replica of DATA/daninhas_full/ generated by scripts/make_micro_dataset.py (all 5 classes, both splits, ~806 train + ~209 test images total — see .specs/adr/0004-micro-dataset-and-golden-run.md's 2026-08-23 amendment) so `make smoke` / tests/test_golden_run.py can run trainer.py (historical name demo.py) end-to-end on CPU in a few seconds.

config_kmh._comment: Sized for the micro dataset's ~796-image unlabeled pool (806 train images - 10 initial labeled, per the smoke script's --n_init_labeled 10). Only exercised by the hierarchical strategies (SSRAEKmeansHCSampling/VCTexKmeansHCSampling), which are not smoke-tested here (see known-issues.md KI-13: hardcoded device='cuda'). Kept for schema completeness only.
